title: R2 transfer contact-state and ESD conventional-confound control
scope: R2 transfer, shipping, remount, and cross-facility campaigns
principal_claim_boundary: Passing this control can bound one class of transfer-induced contact/electrical-state changes. It is not evidence of quantum mechanism, facility equivalence, device stability, or ESD immunity.

dark_iv.rule: Use the exact same prospectively frozen grid/configuration PRE and POST. Null configuration fields make the record INCOMPLETE; this contract does not invent a safe probe condition.

status_logic.INCOMPLETE: missing PRE/POST pair, mismatched configuration, missing raw/provenance/uncertainty/sentinel record, or acceptance limit absent
status_logic.FAIL: complete record and any prospectively declared contact-state limit exceeded, or sentinel/visual/electrical QC declares a failure
status_logic.PASS: complete record, all prospectively declared limits satisfied, and no sentinel/visual/electrical QC failure
status_logic.BLOCKED: upstream transfer-fixture or metrology gate prevents interpretable execution

esd_sentinel.rule: A sentinel response is evidence about the sentinel under its own documented response function; it is not automatically a quantitative estimate of stress at the DUT. Missing response calibration or interpretation rule is INCOMPLETE, not PASS.

predefined_exclusions: rows explicitly rejected by a prospectively frozen instrument-overrange/compliance rule
device declared nonfunctional before PRE by an already-frozen QC rule
forbidden_exclusions: removing a large PRE/POST shift because it is inconvenient
dropping a transferred substrate after seeing POST data without a frozen QC rule
conventional_explanations_preserved: contact pressure or pad registration change

synthetic_software_fixture.classification: synthetic software test only; not R2 measurement
